# `ew apply`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew apply`

```text
ew apply [--project <project>] [--preview] [--one-step] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--preview` | no | no |
| `--one-step` | no | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | every line commits |
| 1 | a prevent or domain rule refuses a line |
| 2 | usage, a malformed log, an unresolvable reference, a refused command, open, lock and save errors |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.apply-result/1`, schema [`ew.apply-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.apply-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.apply-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `committed` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The lines that committed. |
| `lines` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The lines (transactions) of the log. |
| `preview` | [`ApplyChanges`](#applychanges) or `null` | no |  | The changes of `--preview`; `null` without it. |
| `saved` | boolean | yes |  | Whether the project was saved. |

### ApplyChanges

The changes `ew apply --preview` reports.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `records` | array of [`RecordChange`](#recordchange) | yes |  | The changed records. |
| `tags` | array of [`DerivedRowChange`](#derivedrowchange) | yes |  | The changed tags. |
| `xrefs` | array of [`DerivedRowChange`](#derivedrowchange) | yes |  | The changed cross-references. |

### DerivedRowChange

One changed derived value (a tag or a cross-reference).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | yes |  | The value after. |
| `before` | string | yes |  | The value before. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | What changed. |

### RecordChange

One changed record.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `change` | string | yes |  | `Created`, `Updated` or `Deleted`. |
| `fields` | array of string | yes |  | The changed fields of an update. |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The record ID. |
| `kind` | string | yes |  | The record kind. |
